PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Prioritized conditions that need an operator decision or action, with clear ownership and a verified recovery path.
QUEUE_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: New work will appear here when an owning service reports a condition that needs operator action.
FILTERED_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Reset or change the filters to see other operational work.
PERMISSION_TITLE: This operational work is not available to you
PERMISSION_DESCRIPTION: Your current platform access does not allow this view or action. Nothing was changed.
ERROR_TITLE: Operational work could not be loaded
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: The Platform API did not return current operational work. Check the connection and try again.
CONFLICT_TITLE: This item changed while you were working
CONFLICT_DESCRIPTION: Your change was not applied. Reload the current item before deciding what to do next.
DETAIL_DESCRIPTION: Review the impact, source evidence, work history, and the service that confirms resolution.
RESOLVED_READ_ONLY_DESCRIPTION: Work coordination is now read-only. The retained history remains available for investigation.
ACTIONS_DESCRIPTION: These actions help operators coordinate. They do not change the underlying problem or grant access to its source.
REMINDER_REASON_PLACEHOLDER: Explain what should be checked when this item returns
NO_ALLOWED_ACTIONS: You can review this item, but your current access does not include a coordination action.
ASSIGNEES_ERROR: Available operators could not be loaded. Assignment remains unavailable until the list is current.
REMINDER_REASON_REQUIRED: Explain why this item should return later.
HISTORY_EMPTY: No one has changed the work status yet.
HISTORY_NEEDS_ATTENTION: This item returned to needs attention
JOBS_PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Inspect the source evidence behind one operational work item without changing the owning service's result.
JOB_NOT_SELECTED_TITLE: Select an item from Needs attention
JOB_NOT_SELECTED_DESCRIPTION: Open a background-work item from Needs attention to investigate its current source evidence here.
BACKGROUND_JOB_FAILED_TITLE: Background work stopped before it finished
BACKGROUND_JOB_FAILED_EXPLANATION: The owning service reported that this work could not complete.
BACKGROUND_JOB_FAILED_IMPACT: The requested outcome remains incomplete until the owning service finishes successfully.
BACKGROUND_JOB_FAILED_PRIORITY: Failed work that still needs resolution is prioritized for investigation.
BACKGROUND_JOB_RESOLUTION_CONDITION: The owning service reports that the source work completed or otherwise reached its canonical resolved state.
